headline: Public Equity is 35% of the Total Plan model and an implied 55% of its risk
takeaway: Why: Public Equity’s sleeves carry the model’s highest assumed volatilities (13.6–21.5%) and move closely together (correlations 0.57–0.91), so their risks add up. Core bonds are assumed to have low volatility (5.6–6.7%) and to be nearly uncorrelated with developed equity (−0.03 to −0.04), so they take capital without adding much risk.
